_comment: Mutation testing for packages/schemas, the second target after packages/core. Rationale: this package is rule #2's single validation source — every boundary in the app parses through it — and coverage here is already 100%, which is exactly the state where line coverage stops telling you anything. A weakened constraint (a `.min(1)` that becomes `.min(0)`, an enum member deleted, a `.uuid()` dropped) leaves every line covered and every test green while the boundary silently widens. It is also pure and I/O-free, so mutants are deterministic. packages/api is deliberately NOT next: it is I/O-shaped and slow to mutate. Run with `pnpm --filter @athanor/schemas mutation`.
_plugins_comment: Declared explicitly: Stryker's default plugin discovery globs node_modules and does not follow pnpm's symlinked layout, so the runner is installed and resolvable but not auto-loaded.
_thresholds_comment: `break` is the CI gate (.github/workflows/mutation.yml). Measured 74.04%; set to 71, never aspirationally — a threshold nobody can meet becomes a red job people learn to ignore. Ratchet UP as tests land, never down (core.md precedent, same rule as the coverage floors). `low` is kept equal to `break` so a green run does not also log an 'under low threshold' warning, which is the same desensitization by another route. Ratchet history: 63 → 67 when issue #182 landed (entitlements.ts, moment.ts and post-media.ts each went to 100%, taking the package 65.21% → 69.88%), then 67 → 71 when the constraint cluster of issue #24 landed (69.88% → 74.04%). Note the measured chain 62.69 → 65.21 → 69.88 → 74.04 lives HERE and in CI and nowhere else — reports/mutation/ is gitignored, which is exactly how the 65.21 → 69.88 jump sat unrecorded for two commits and left the gate 7 points below reality. Re-measured on 2026-08-17 for #392: 74.04 was stale in the other direction. The package has grown 601 → 868 mutants since that number was written, and the score had drifted DOWN to 73.01 with nobody recording it — the same gitignored-report blind spot, pointing the opposite way, so read 74.04 as a high-water mark rather than the state of the suite. #392's action-list, mirror and fund-shape tests then took it 73.01 → 73.85 (641 killed of 868). `break` deliberately stays at 71 rather than ratcheting to 73: at 73 the band would absorb only ~10 new unkilled mutants (641/878 = 73.01%) where it absorbs ~34 today (641/902 = 71.06%), and it is the BAND, not the headroom, that stops a blameless additive change from reding the gate.
_band_comment: Why ~3.0 points of slack here when packages/core runs on 0.36: the score is a ratio, so ADDING code adds to the denominator immediately and to the numerator only once tests follow. With 445 killed, `break: 71` absorbs 25 new unkilled mutants (445/626 = 71.09%) — roughly six new enum members — before it reds. Core is near-saturated and its additions are small relative to 733 mutants; this package has an open backlog and a growing vocabulary, and a gate that goes red for a blameless additive change teaches people to lower it, which is the one move forbidden here. Recompute the band, do not widen it by feel: solve killed/(total+n) >= break for n.
_baseline_comment: First run scored 62.69% against 100% line coverage. That gap IS the finding: every line of this package is executed by a test and a third of its meaning is unasserted. Five tests added in the same slice took it to 65.21% by closing the three constraint holes the report exposed — a physical event with only ONE of lat/long (both existing tests nulled the pair, where `||` and `&&` agree), a link merely CONTAINING http:// rather than starting with it, and an uphold verdict WITH a severity, whose accept arm was so untested that the refine could have been a constant `false` rejecting every uphold — the report_upheld/-200 path, rule #1. Issue #182 then took entitlements.ts, moment.ts and post-media.ts to 100% each — 65.21% → 69.88%, 420 killed of 601 — by asserting the invariants those three schemas exist to protect instead of that parsing succeeded. Issue #24's constraint cluster then closed the last 18 of those — every surviving MethodExpression and Regex mutant across event.ts, help.ts, project.ts, story-segment.ts and waitlist.ts — plus the two refine tokens ('stream_url_required' / 'location_required') and their issue codes: 69.88% → 74.04%, 445 killed of 601. What that cluster taught, and what the next one should copy: a nullable column tested only with null asserts nothing (project.ts terms, waitlist.ts source), a price tested only at 0 satisfies a floor and a ceiling alike, a regex tested only with a string containing no match at all never exercises its anchors, and a schema that RE-DECLARES a field rather than picking it carries its own copy of the bound — the row's assertion says nothing about the insert's. The remaining 156, by mutator: ~76 vocabulary members (StringLiteral + ArrayDeclaration — blanking 'musica' or 'milestone_help' silently narrows a boundary; asserting a LITERAL token, never a loop over the constant, is what kills these), 63 .pick()/.omit() flags (BooleanLiteral + ObjectLiteral, schemas.md's canonical derivation mechanism), ~17 Zod message strings deliberately left alone because user-facing copy lives in @athanor/i18n (rule #5) and Zod's internal text reaches no user — which puts the ceiling near 97%, not 100%. Full triage in .scratch/testing-bar/issues/19 and on GitHub issue #24.
